name: Signature

components.expression: a grounded, intense stare, the weight of the earth in her gaze.
components.effects: Fine motes of {{ACCENT_SOFT}} dust and drifting leaf litter swirl gently around her feet, stirred by unseen earth magic.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Terrador, visible in the distance among the trees, an Elder Dragon of deep burnt-sienna and rich-bronze scales veined with vivid turquoise, trailing drifting dust and stone fragments, wings like slabs of weathered stone edged in polished copper

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses proven cross-cutting wardrobe pieces (gown, jewelry set, heels, ambient glow) in Draknara's own Deep Burnt Sienna/Vivid Turquoise palette, with her own spirit-totem signature staff, plus the existing ancient-grove background (fits Earth/Shaman thematically).
